# teams_survivable_branch_appliance_policy (Resource)

Manages the SurvivableBranchAppliancePolicy policy via New-CsTeamsSurvivableBranchAppliancePolicy / Get-CsTeamsSurvivableBranchAppliancePolicy / Set-CsTeamsSurvivableBranchAppliancePolicy / Remove-CsTeamsSurvivableBranchAppliancePolicy.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Name (Identity) of the object; also the create key. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `branch_appliance_fqdns` (String) Maps to the -BranchApplianceFqdns parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
